item.title: NCAA MEN’S LACROSSE: Palumb, Lee claim America East weekly awards
item.description: BOSTON, Mass. – University at Albany men’s lacrosse student-athletes Jackson Palumb and Justin Lee each collected weekly awards from the America East, the conference announced Monday afternoon. Palumb was named the America East Offensive Player of the Week, and Lee was named the conference’s Defensive Player of the Week. item.title: NCAA WOMEN’S LACROSSE: Cincebox, Carroll, earn America East weekly awards
item.description: BOSTON, Mass. – University at Albany women’s lacrosse senior goalkeeper Grace Cincebox and freshman midfielder Mya Carroll have received weekly awards, the America East announced on Monday. Cincebox was named Goalkeeper of the Week, while Carroll earned Rookie of the Week honors following the Great Danes’ opening split against Holy Cross and No.18 Stony Brook.
